question: For raw-C root bracket 1 and the two punctured real lambda boxes, does the exact lambda-zero Bessel direction plus the normalization-invariant Q=4 sensitivity anchor give a rigorous positive sensitivity and a sign-separated, narrow actual-direction tube at Q_switch=-29/10 under an affine backward-x comparison?
one_output: One BESSEL_PRECONDITIONED_SWITCH_TRANSPORT verdict whose fields are the outward Q_switch intervals for actual s, mean-value p, and the Bessel-relative actual rho on each declared lambda box.
non_claim: This transport does not evaluate the declared Gamma_1, its nonzero-lambda derivative or sign, continue a root, construct a Weyl m-function, spectral measure, RAQ object, or physical prediction.
controls: check the delta/lambda and sensitivity equations and the closed 0-to-lambda mean-value segment independently with exact algebra and theorem-scope guards
require the 1024-panel monotone exponential-kernel enclosure to be contained in the 512-panel enclosure, with the omitted positive tail bounded analytically
require 80/120-decimal Arb/acb overlap, nonzero Bessel denominators, real-residue containment, and the expected side of the lambda-zero Bessel direction

upstream_results.role: pins the exact root-1 kappa bracket and the lambda-zero Bessel family used as the affine preconditioner
pins s(4) in [27/10,240/53] and its scale-invariant forced-Wronskian derivation
pins the actual plus-recessive family and the invariant rho in [-1,1] barrier on x>=3

primary_sources.source: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, modified-Bessel equation and recurrences, sections 10.25 and 10.29
primary_sources.used_for: the exact lambda-zero K_(i kappa) direction at Q=4 and Q_switch
primary_sources.not_used_for: the nonzero-lambda solution, Gamma_1, spectral data, or RAQ

primary_sources.source: Fredrik Johansson, Arb: Efficient Arbitrary-Precision Midpoint-Radius Interval Arithmetic
primary_sources.used_for: outward elementary and complex-Bessel ball arithmetic

declared_conventions.execution: SymPy exact identities plus python-flint Arb/acb finite monotone exponential-kernel panel sums and analytic positive-tail bounds; no ODE, root, black-box quadrature, finite difference, or sampling grid

assumptions: The pinned actual-family invariant barrier applies uniformly to the closed |lambda|<=1e-4 segment and root bracket 1 while x>=3.

The sensitivity-anchor proof uses only uniform |lambda|<=1e-4 coefficient bounds, so its displayed interval also controls every intermediate parameter on the closed segment from zero to a declared punctured-box point.
For each fixed parameter, the plus-recessive family is differentiable in lambda and its logarithmic direction is invariant under lambda-dependent positive amplitude rescaling.
The lambda-zero K_(i kappa)(x) denominator balls exclude zero at both evaluated endpoints; imaginary balls are residue diagnostics and must contain zero.

The affine coefficient envelope intentionally retains the full invariant rho barrier. It can certify a narrow Bessel-relative endpoint tube but is not advertised as the later complete differentiated Gamma_1 transport.
